text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin has a short stride, but the
rush she gets in the
homestretch is fierce.
More than anything else, she longs to win.

A bit of searching reveals a video of a race
she ran before applying to
Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

Her expression has no hint of impatience.
She's running comfortably
in the back,
calm and controlled.

She takes it slow. Usually, letting the
frontrunners save their energy
for the final
sprint would be a mistake.

But in one beautiful stroke, she flips those
odds around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaagh!

With a burst of fearsome strength, she
tears away from the pack.

She rages forward like a storm, and takes
the win!
I scramble through Taishin's portfolio to check the times. Her speed in the first half isn't anything special, but the second half...

The last three furlongs are incredibly fast
for this type of race!

She got impatient at the tryouts and
wasted her energy early on, so
she didn't
have enough to sustain her last spurt.

It's early to be thinking strategy, but I
can't help tracking Taishin
down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You're the trainer from yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're the trainer who was with
Taishin last night! Could this be
what I
think it is?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're here to scout her?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The hell does that mean? I flipped out on
you last night. Why would...

She looks at me perplexed, and I tell her
about the race footage I
watched.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh huh... So?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh no...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I-I'm, I'm... I'm sho touuuched!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's gooo! This trainer's got the stuff!
Taishin, this one's speciaaal!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Please... You think everyone's special.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So?! Are you gonna accept?! Are you
gonna team up?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wh-why would I pair up with this weirdo?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A shame. All would have sailed smoothly if
only you were on board.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wha?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to intrude. I have a pressing matter
at hand, and I need your
assistance, Narita
Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Pre... President?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To cut straight to the point, I have
received multiple reports that you
are
unfit for Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The reasons are many: your recent
lackluster results, concerns for your

wellbeing, and—however noble the
intention—your repeated
disregard for
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I presented counterarguments on your
behalf, but as matters stand... I
must ask
you to aid me yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: My... self?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You see, the concerns about you were
voiced predominantly by
academy faculty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The simplest way to convince them is to
offer proof of your abilities.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, endeavor to dispel the accusations
against you, Narita
Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
("Dispel the accusations," she says... How
the hell am I supposed to
pull that off?)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOO! We can't let them expel you,
Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
T-Ticket, you... Don't tell me you were
eavesdropping!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'd NEVER! I was just listening intently!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's exactly what eavesdropping is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. But the situation is more dire than
I expected.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide?! Not you too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm surrounded...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, if we are to achieve what the
president indicated, there is but
one path
available.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's a way?! You're amazing,
Hayahideee! Just say the word!
How can
we help?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I really don't see why you're so worked up
about this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If we are to inspire high expectations of
your racing potential, it
follows that we
must demonstrate it on the track.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We need to gather people for a
scrimmage. The two of us will join as
well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah! That's perfect! Let's do this,
Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You think I need your pity? That I need
you to throw a race just to get
a win?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Not for a second. Putting me aside, you
should know well that there's
one racer
here who doesn't know the meaning of
holding back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... I guess...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The reason we are trying to help is quite
simple. Though that which is
simple is
often difficult to put in words.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So forget it. I look forward to seeing you
at the scrimmage, Taishin.
